course.title: Hazards and Disaster Management
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Write short notes on any three of the following issues:
(i) Root causes and dynamic pressure in vulnerability analysis.
(ii) Importance of Damage, Loss, and Need assessment (DLNA) in disaster recovery.
(iii) Activities performed during search and rescue (SAR) operation
